specifications.title: FIPS 197 · AES
specifications.status_note: NIST standard; the 2023 update leaves the algorithms unchanged.

specifications.title: SP 800-67 Rev. 2 · TDEA
specifications.status_note: Withdrawn by NIST. Listed for historical cryptanalysis, not new deployment.

specifications.title: RFC 8439 · ChaCha20 and Poly1305
specifications.status_note: Informational RFC defining the IETF variants; not an Internet Standards Track document.

specifications.title: FIPS 180-4 · Secure Hash Standard
specifications.status_note: NIST's publication page records a planned revision. Parameters here identify the 2015 edition.

specifications.title: FIPS 202 · SHA-3, SHAKE and Keccak-p
specifications.status_note: NIST records a planned update and an Appendix B erratum; this directory identifies the 2015 definitions.

specifications.title: SP 800-232 · Ascon-based cryptography
specifications.status_note: Final NIST specification. Standardized instances are distinct from earlier Ascon submissions.

specifications.title: SP 800-38B · CMAC
specifications.status_note: NIST's publication page records a planned revision. Listed instances use AES and full-length tags.

specifications.title: GB/T 32905-2016 · SM3
specifications.status_note: Chinese national standard. The catalog identifies the 2016 algorithm definition.

specifications.title: GB/T 32907-2016 · SM4
specifications.status_note: Chinese national standard specifying the 128-bit-key, 128-bit-block algorithm.

specifications.title: RFC 3713 · Camellia
specifications.status_note: Informational algorithm specification by the designers, not an Internet Standards Track document.

specifications.title: RFC 5794 · ARIA
specifications.status_note: Informational description of ARIA, not an Internet Standards Track document.

specifications.title: RFC 4269 · SEED
specifications.status_note: Informational KISA specification that obsoletes RFC 4009; not an Internet Standards Track document.

specifications.title: PRESENT · Original design specification
specifications.status_note: Original research specification by Bogdanov et al., including both key schedules; not a claim about a current standards edition.

specifications.title: Salsa20 · Original specification
specifications.status_note: Original designer specification, not an RFC. Listed instances use the full 20-round cipher and original nonce layout.

specifications.title: RFC 1321 · MD5
specifications.status_note: Historical Informational specification; its security considerations are updated by RFC 6151. Publication does not imply collision resistance.

specifications.title: RFC 6151 · MD5 security considerations
specifications.status_note: Updates RFC 1321 and RFC 2104. MD5 is not acceptable where collision resistance is required.

primitives.name: AES
primitives.description: Standardized Rijndael instances with a 128-bit block and three key sizes.

primitives.name: SM4
primitives.description: Chinese standardized block cipher with four 32-bit state words and a nonlinear round transformation.

primitives.name: Camellia
primitives.description: Feistel block cipher with input/output whitening and keyed FL layers between six-round groups.

primitives.name: ARIA
primitives.description: Substitution-permutation cipher with alternating substitution layers and key-length-dependent round counts.

primitives.name: SEED
primitives.description: KISA block cipher using a 16-round Feistel network and a 128-bit key.

primitives.name: PRESENT
primitives.description: Lightweight 64-bit block cipher with a 4-bit substitution layer, bit permutation and two key schedules.

primitives.name: 3DES / TDEA
primitives.description: Three-stage DES construction, retained as a historical research target.

primitives.name: ChaCha20
primitives.description: ARX stream cipher; the registered IETF instance fixes the nonce and counter sizes.

primitives.name: Salsa20
primitives.description: ARX stream cipher with column/row double rounds; the registered instances use the original 64-bit nonce and 64-bit block counter.

primitives.name: SM3
primitives.description: Chinese standardized 256-bit hash with message expansion, 64 compression steps and XOR feed-forward.

primitives.name: SHA-2
primitives.description: Fixed-output hash family with distinct initial values and output sizes for each instance.

primitives.name: SHA-3
primitives.description: Fixed-output sponge hashes using Keccak; their domain separation distinguishes them from other Keccak hashes.

primitives.name: SHA-1
primitives.description: Historical 160-bit hash retained for cryptanalysis; distinct from SHA-0 and the SHA-2 family.

primitives.name: MD5
primitives.description: Historical 128-bit hash retained for cryptanalysis, not for applications requiring collision resistance.

primitives.name: SHAKE
primitives.description: Keccak-based functions with caller-selected output length and XOF-specific domain separation.

primitives.name: Keccak permutations
primitives.description: Unkeyed state permutations underlying SHA-3 and SHAKE; each instance fixes its width and round schedule.

primitives.name: Ascon AEAD
primitives.description: Authenticated encryption from the final Ascon-based lightweight cryptography standard.

primitives.name: ChaCha20-Poly1305
primitives.description: Authenticated encryption combining the IETF ChaCha20 instance with Poly1305.

primitives.name: CMAC
primitives.description: Block-cipher-based message authentication; registered instances use AES with full tags.

instances.name: Camellia-128
instances.note: 18 Feistel rounds; the two intervening FL/FLINV layers and whitening are not counted as rounds.

instances.name: Camellia-192
instances.note: 24 Feistel rounds; the three intervening FL/FLINV layers and whitening are not counted as rounds.

instances.name: Camellia-256
instances.note: 24 Feistel rounds; the three intervening FL/FLINV layers and whitening are not counted as rounds.

instances.name: PRESENT-80
instances.note: 31 substitution-permutation rounds followed by a final key addition, not a 32nd round.

instances.name: PRESENT-128
instances.note: Uses the 128-bit key schedule; the round structure matches PRESENT-80.

instances.name: Three-key TDEA
instances.note: Three DES stages, 16 DES rounds per stage. The 192-bit encoding includes parity; 168 key bits do not imply 168-bit security.

instances.name: Salsa20/20 (128-bit key)
instances.note: The 128-bit key is repeated in the state with the 16-byte-key constants; it is not zero-padded to 256 bits.

instances.name: SHA-1
instances.note: Historical research target with broken collision resistance; not a recommendation for new cryptographic use.

instances.name: MD5
instances.note: 64 compression steps arranged in four rounds of 16 steps. Historical research target with broken collision resistance.

instances.name: Keccak-p[1600,12]
instances.note: Uses the last 12 rounds of Keccak-f[1600], not its first 12 rounds.

instances.name: Ascon-AEAD128 (full tag)
instances.note: Final 2025 definition, with no tag truncation; earlier submission variants retain separate identities.
